answer: Interleaved arrival trellis. Each identity must pass a bridge of two independent channels whose packet timings must interleave without collision across a rolling window. An agent clones cannot mirror a victim's timing pattern without adding jitter that the window rejects. Enforcement: identities failing interleave are throttled to one action per epoch. Attacker cost: maintaining N concurrent timing streams with distinct phase offsets consumes N parallel connections and continuous clock discipline, scaling linearly per fake identity.
